 Deals Black Friday Beauty Deals on Amazon: Up to 63% Off Clinique, Medicube and More
 Shop Amazon’s Black Friday now through Nov. 30 — it’s filled with so many top beauty deals. Nov. 19, 2026, 10:01 AM EST Shannon Garlin
 Editor
 Skip to table of contents Share Add TODAY to Google In this article Amazon Black Friday skin care deals 
 Amazon Black Friday makeup deals 
 Amazon Black Friday hair deals 
 Amazon Black Friday beauty tool deals
 How we chose 
 See 2 More Amazon’s Black Friday has officially kicked off, and it’s filled with Shop TODAY Beauty Awards winners , viral products and giftable finds. 
 During this 12-day sales event, you’ll score deals across hair care, makeup and skin care categories, plus markdowns on sought-after beauty tools. Trust us, we know Black Friday can be an overwhelming experience, so that’s why we did the heavy lifting for you. Below, you’ll find a roundup of our favorite deals on everything from a Living Proof hair mask to Medicube skin care and more beauty-loving finds.
 Be sure to check back, as Amazon will be dropping new deals throughout their Black Friday sales event, and we’ll be raving about our favorites. 
 Amazon Black Friday skin care deals
 CeraVe PM Facial Moisturizing Lotion 
 $ 13.62 $ 19.99 Amazon Now 32% off What to know Key ingredients: Hyaluronic acid and niacinamide Winter brings dry skin; thankfully, you’ll save 32% on this editor-loved nightly moisturizer. The brand says it’s packed with ceramides, hyaluronic acid and niacinamide to help calm skin and maintain the natural barrier. 
 Biodance Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask 
 $ 13.99 $ 19.00 Amazon Now 26% off What to know Award: Best overall overnight beauty treatment  | Size: 1.19 oz  | Count: 4 facial sheets Stock up on these viral and award-winning sheet masks . They apply opaque and slowly turn clear as the moisturizing ingredients absorb into your skin. You can wear it for three to four hours, but the brand recommends leaving it on overnight for the best results. 
 Medicube Collagen Jelly Cream 
 $ 13.99 $ 19.98 Amazon Now 30% off What to know Size: 3.71 ounces  | Key ingredients: Niacinamide and collagen  | Texture: Jelly This Shop TODAY multi-winning Beauty Awards brand is offering impressive Black Friday markdowns, including 30% off on this unique “jelly cream.” It’s packed with hydrating ingredients to help you achieve that “glass skin” look, per the brand. 
 BETA Your shortcut to editor approved picks
 Burt's Bees Classics Set 
 $ 17.50 $ 25.00 Amazon Now 30% off What to know Pieces: 6  | What's included?: Hand cream and salve, foot cream, cuticle cream, lip balm, Res-Q Ointment Black Friday is a great time to score deals on holiday beauty sets , and this Burt’s Bees option is filled with the brand’s classics. You’ll get six items, like the lip balm and hand salve, for under $20.
 grace & stella Energizing Under Eye Mask 
 $ 18.95 $ 27.95 Amazon Now 32% off What to know Quantity: 6-, 24- or 48-count sets available Our readers and editors can’t get enough of these revitalizing eye masks. The brand says they help target fine lines and dark circles, and our editors recommend keeping them in the fridge for instant depuffing. 
 Amazon Black Friday makeup deals
 Lancôme Lash Idôle Volumizing Mascara 
 $ 14.00 $ 30.00 Amazon Now 53% off What to know Sizes: 2 Named “best buildable formula” during our Shop TODAY Ranked series, this luxe mascara has a silicone wand that I [Garlin] found grabs each lash and doesn’t clump while applying. At $14, I will be stocking up on a couple during Cyber Week.
 Lancôme Lash Idôle Volumizing Mascara Courtesy of Shannon Garlin The Original MakeUp Eraser 7-Day Set 
 $ 17.50 $ 25.00 Amazon Now 30% off What to know Pack count: 7 wipes  | Colors: 14  | Fabric: Microfiber Not only will you save money now, but you’ll also save money in the long run with these reusable makeup erasing cloths. An editor-loved product, these wipes will take off stubborn makeup with just water. 
 Clinique Chubby Stick Moisturizing Lip Colour Tinted Lip Balm 
 $ 18.20 $ 26.00 Amazon Now 30% off What to know Size: 0.1 oz  | Shades: 20+  | Key ingredients: Mango and shea butters I [Garlin] have used Clinique Chubby Sticks since my high school days and love them for their buildable color and balm-like formula. They come in so many natural shades and make for a great stocking stuffer. 
 Laura Geller Baked Balance-N-Glow Illuminating Foundation 
 $ 20.89 $ 34.00 Amazon Now 39% off What to know Shades: Nine  | Finish: Demi-matte natural glow  | Coverage : Light to Medium  | Size: 0.28 oz. Laura Geller formulates her makeup for mature skin, and this beloved baked foundation provides buildable coverage to brighten the skin, without sinking into fine lines. You’ll save nearly 40% on this reader and editor favorite. 
 Laura Geller Baked Foundation Courtesy of Colleen Sullivan IT Cosmetics Do It All Radiant Concealer 
 $ 21.00 $ 30.00 Amazon Now 30% off What to know Award: Best hydrating concealer  | Score: 4.5/5  | Size: 0.23 fl oz  | Shades: 30  | Key ingredients: Niacinamide, hyaluronic acid, vitamins B5 & E Skin care meets makeup with this 2025 Mature Beauty Awards -winning concealer. Its multi-vitamin formula provides intense hydration while covering dark circles and minimizing fine lines — without the creasing!
 Amazon Black Friday hair deals
 L'Oreal Paris Elvive Hyaluron Plump Shampoo and Conditioner Set 
 $ 17.05 $ 20.98 Amazon Now 19% off What to know Size: 26.5 oz.  | Key Ingredients: Hyaluronic acid Over 20,000 Amazon shoppers bought this L’Oreal shampoo and conditioner set in the last month, so you can expect this deal to go fast. The hair duo works on all hair types and provides moisture for up to 72 hours, per the brand. 
 R+Co Spiritualized Dry Shampoo Mist 
 $ 22.40 $ 32.00 Amazon Now 30% off What to know Size: 4.2 oz.  | Key ingredients: Glycerin, silica, castor oil, camellia seed oil The brand says this dry shampoo mist contains a “micellar formula” that instantly absorbs oil while hydrating the scalp. We love that it’s a non-aerosol option, making it easy to travel with. 
 Dr. Groot Miracle in Shower Treatment 
 $ 26.40 $ 33.00 Amazon Now 20% off What to know Award: Best hair growth treatment  | Overall score: 4.5/5  | Size: 8.4 fl. oz  | Key Ingredients: Biotin, rosemary oil, salicylic acid, niacinamide  | Hair Type: All  | Fragrance: Yes, fresh lemon verbena and herbal scent Dr. Groot’s Miracle In-Shower Treatment not only exfoliates the scalp, but it’s also so hydrating that our editors say it can be used in lieu of conditioner. 
 “I also couldn’t stop myself from running my fingers through my hair every few minutes or so because my hair felt so, so soft. Again, this is without any styling products!” says writer Danielle Murphy. 
 Dr. Groot Miracle in Shower Treatment Courtesy of Danielle Murphy Dae Hair Cactus Fruit 3-In-1 Styling Cream 
 $ 24.00 $ 30.00 Amazon Now 20% off What to know Award: Best overall styling cream  | Overall Score: 5/5  | Size : 5 oz  | Key ingredients: Dragon fruit, prickly pear seed oil and cactus flower extract  | Hair types: Medium, fine or thick hair Grab this editor-loved Dae styling wand while it’s on sale for 20% off. The award winner is a 3-in-1 tool that tames flyaways, adds shine and smooths frizz. I [Garlin] love using it for low buns or just taming strands at my part. 
 Dae Cactus Fruit 3-in-1 Styling Wand Courtesy Shannon Garlin Living Proof Triple Bond Complex Leave-In Treatment and Hair Mask 
 $ 31.50 $ 45.00 Amazon Now 30% off What to know This weekly leave-in treatment and hair mask is editor-approved and scientifically proven to make your hair eight times stronger, according to the brand. 
 Size: 1.5 oz.  | Key ingredients: Encapsulated cellular oil, jojoba esters Score up to 30% off on Living Proof products, including this weekly leave-in treatment and hair mask. The brand says you can expect instant hydration, frizz control and stronger hair.
 Amazon Black Friday beauty tool deals
 Kitsch XL Microfiber Hair Towel Wrap 
 $ 15.99 $ 22.99 Amazon Now 30% off What to know Size: 40 x 24 in  | Material: Microfiber Experts previously shared that microfiber wraps are gentler on your hair than your average bath towel. This option from Kitsch has plush fabric and is extra-large, making it suitable for longer hair. 
 Crest 3D Whitestrips Professional Effects 
 $ 29.99 $ 45.99 Amazon Now 35% off What to know Key ingredients: Hydrogen peroxide  | Number of treatments: 22 Holiday deal events are always a good time to stock up on Crest 3D Whitening strips, which are on sale for $30 right now. According to the brand, you’ll get 22 treatments that’ll whiten your teeth by 19 levels. 
 Chi Original Ceramic Flat Iron 
 $ 36.56 $ 100.00 Amazon Now 63% off What to know Material: Ceramic  | Temperature: Up to 397 Fahrenheit Whether you need to replace your hair straightener or are looking for the perfect gift for your mom, sister or daughter, this hair straightener is 63% off. Its multi-function ceramic plates provide sleek strands or bouncy curls, per the brand
 Medicube Booster Pro 
 $ 149.00 $ 249.00 Amazon Now 40% off What to know Award for: Best innovative skin tool  | Score: 4/5  | Settings: Adjustable intensity levels  | Powered By: Rechargeable battery  | Serum Included?: No Our experts rave about the benefits of LED light therapy and microcurrents for maturing skin, which is why dermatologists, along with our testers, named this 6-in-1 beauty device the “best innovative skin tool.” During Amazon’s Black Friday sales, you can save $100 on it!
 Shark FlexStyle Air Styling & Drying System 
 $ 249.99 $ 385.99 Amazon Now 35% off What to know Colors: 5  | Attachments: Paddle bursh, concentrator, round brush, diffuser, frizz finishing tool, curlers Multi-hair styling tools have been a hot commodity for holiday beauty gifting, so you’ll want to take advantage of this deal on Shark’s FlexStyle. It comes with seven attachments for a voluminous blowout, bouncy waves and more versatile hairdos.
 How we chose
 To find Amazon’s best beauty deals for Black Friday, we combed through thousands of products across Amazon.com. We consider factors like high average ratings, markdown prices of over 20% off and verified shopper ratings. We also choose products based on insight from price trackers like CamelCamelCamel, Keepa and Alexa shopping, as well as expert recommendations from previous reporting on Shop TODAY and staff-tested award winners .
